g.text: FRAME: END FRAMES, SPINE, HEAD STAND
Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-406 Metal detector conveyor (built frame, used head) · rev B
SS 304 (ASTM A240 sheet + plate / A554 tube / A276 bar)
No product contact (pack closed): #4 brushed or bead blast; passivate ASTM A967
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: u from the MFZ end (|x| 475), v from the bottom edge (z 763). Outfeed +y plate: same without P, with K; infeed plates: S and B as slots.
END FRAME 102 WELDMENT (1:4), FROM -Y (101: SLOTS + TAKE-UP LUGS)
Leg 40 x 40 x 2 welded to the plate outside face (3 fillet, 60 overlap); 2 cross tubes 40 x 40 x 2 at u 85 / 185 under the bed,
brace 40 x 40 x 2 between the legs at z 300; bed 3 mm on top, welded intermittent 3-25-100; foot pad 60 x 60 x 8 tapped M16.
Top plates 60 x 80 x 8 welded at the leg brace positions, 2 x Ø9 each (H1 M8 to the braces); stand beam bolts on at x 0 (4 x Ø9).
HEAD STAND 104 (1:4), WELDED; CONFIRM LUGS ON THE ACTUAL HEAD
Beam 80 x 40 x 3, posts 50 x 50 x 3, top plates 70 x 120 x 8 with slots 9 x 30 along y; +y top plate gets the G10 pad and nylon bushes (H7).
1. Laser cut the side plates as a set of 4; mark u/v datum; deburr. Weld the end frames on a table jig: plates 200 ±0.5 apart inside, square to the bed 0.5.
2. After welding, line-bore is not needed: the flange bearings self-align; check the two pulley axes parallel 0.5 over 1,420 at assembly (ITP T3).
3. No steel inside |x| < 475: the end frames stop at u 0. Spine and stand are 570 below the aperture (> 375).
4. Break edges 0.5; #4 brush; passivate ASTM A967.
